title: Sync SDK retry layers, introduce generator facade and lightweight reauth across py/ts/go
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Minor SDK ergonomics: unified retry defaults between languages; added generator-style streaming facade; improved reauth telemetry. No API breaking changes.
description:
Context: Multiple SDK teams (py/ts/go) observed subtle UX & telemetry gaps around streaming generators and credential reauth. Motivation: reduce cross-language surprises for users adopting long-lived streams and make retry defaults less chatty while preserving resilience. This PR implements a language-neutral retry layer specification, a generator-style stream facade for ergonomics parity, and a lightweight reauth token lease telemetry hook across SDKs. Changes are designed to be opt-in via new config flags and default to the conservative (backwards compatible) behavior.

What this PR does (high level): unify retry stack semantics (idempotency tagging + quiet exponential backoff), introduce a generator/async-iterator facade compatible with existing pull/push stream APIs, add a lightweight token-lease telemetry event (telemetry.event: "cred.lease.refresh_attempt"), and sync tests and examples across SDKs so behavior is consistent.

Why not more invasive: We intentionally avoided renaming public types; the facade sits alongside current streaming helpers and is gated behind feature flags for a single release to allow adoption.

Checklist:
- [x] Spec and Linear tickets (ENG-3412, ENG-3413) created
- [x] Python, TypeScript, Go SDKs updated with parallel implementations
- [x] Integration tests for long-lived stream reconnects added
- [x] Telemetry hooks added and validated in staging
- [x] Docs snippet added to SDK quickstarts

Compatibility notes: defaults remain backward compatible. New flags: `enable_generator_facade`, `quiet_retry_profiles` and a `cred_lease_telemetry` toggle. Default: false for facade, true for quiet_retry_profiles (to reduce noisy retries), true for cred_lease_telemetry. You can opt out at client init.

Testing performed: unit tests for each SDK; end-to-end integration in the perf-canary lab with simulated token expiry; fuzzed streaming reconnection cases; CI matrix for py/ts/go passes.

Follow-ups: small doc PR to expand migration guide and a dedicated telemetry dashboard to surface cred lease events (tracked in ENG-3430).

review_conversation: Ethan Liu (reviewer): Nice consolidation — can we tighten the retry window for idempotent calls? Observed a small spike in canary when backoff floor is zero.
Priya Nair (author): Good catch — added a jitter floor of 50ms and documented rationale in the retry spec. Re-ran canary. Results included below.
Marcel Gómez (reviewer): Typing/Docs nit in TS facade — suggested stronger examples for error handling and cancellation semantics.
Priya Nair (author): Addressed docs + added example that demonstrates cancel() handling. Also added an e2e test for cancel semantics.
Sofia Tan (reviewer): Go impl looks good; comment about context propagation in generator_facade.go left inline. Also requested one more unit test for simultaneous reconnects.
Priya Nair (author): Added the requested unit test and improved context propagation; CI green now.
merge_outcome: merged (squash) by Marcel Gómez after approvals from Ethan Liu and Sofia Tan. No reverts. Changelog entry included in release notes.
notes_for_release: Syncs SDK ergonomics across languages: generator facade (opt-in), quieter default retry profiles, and lightweight credential-lease telemetry. Recommend enabling `enable_generator_facade` for new consumers and monitoring cred lease events in telemetry during rollout.
